_comment: Phase 2 upstream Pi. Server auto-detects XML vs JSON on the first response byte, so no format flag is needed. Replace the url IP with your Pi's IP on the simulator network. Add more entries to poll multiple Pis. Required: url. Optional: name, poll_ms (default 500), timeout_s (default 2.0), board (default 0, used in /ioio/trigger writeback), write_url (default: derived from url by swapping /ioio/status -> /ioio/trigger).
